PR title: perf(gc): memoize the hosted-credential probe; fix(beads): bd subprocesses die with their parent

PR description:
## Summary

Two independent fixes from the 2026-09-23 maintainer-city incident (work queries timing out ~28/h, host load ~250 on 192 cores).

**1. `perf(gc)`: memoize the hosted-credential probe per city.** `citySelectsHostedBeadsCredentialProvider` composes the whole city config (city.toml + every include + pack discovery) to read one boolean, and the bd environment builder asks up to three times per bd subprocess on the non-Dolt storage-binding path. On maintainer-city a single `gc ready` loaded the 118 KB config **147 times**: 30 s of a 33 s query and 381k `openat` calls (measured with strace + a SIGQUIT goroutine dump mid-gap). ga-s3cnmy (#6401) had already dropped the revision snapshot; this removes the repeated loads. The answer is cached per normalized `city.toml` path in a `sync.Map` and every hit is validated against the size and mtime of each source file the load reported (city.toml and every include), so edits are observed on the next call with no restart. Errors and a city.toml rewritten mid-load are never cached. The `TestHostedCredentialProbeDeclinesTheRevisionSnapshot` guard still holds (same named `hostedCredentialProbeLoad` options).

**2. `fix(beads)`: bd subprocesses die with a hard-exiting parent.** `prepareCommandForTimeout` isolates each bd / `gc-beads-bd.sh` call in its own process group so bd timeouts can group-kill it. That isolation also shields the wrapper tree from an external SIGKILL of the parent's group (Bazel / `go test` timeouts, ctrl-c on `bazel test //cmd/gc:gc_test`): the test binary dies, the wrapper and the gc re-execs under it live on. On cherry this left 510 leaked processes (oldest 21 h). On Linux add `Pdeathsig: SIGKILL` next to `Setpgid`, the same kernel-enforced guarantee `proxyProcessSysProcAttr` uses (ga-9br097). Only the direct child receives it, so a daemonized managed dolt keeps its own lifecycle. Other unix platforms are unchanged.

## Test plan

- [x] `go test ./cmd/gc -run 'HostedCredential|HostedBeads|BdEnv|StorageBinding|CredentialProbe'` green (new: three probes = one load; rewriting the *included* storage.toml invalidates; missing / invalid cities are not memoized)
- [x] `go test ./internal/beads -run 'Timeout|Kill|Exec'` green; the new hard-parent-exit harness test **fails on the previous code** (child still alive after 5 s) and passes with the fix
- [x] `go vet`, `golangci-lint run` on both packages: 0 issues; pre-commit hook (lint-changed, codegen, vet ./...) passed
- [ ] Live: cherry-picked onto the maintainer-city deploy branch and measured `gc ready` before/after (numbers in the follow-up comment)
